text:
Mia Chen: Quick design pass — the rule-card stacking during drag still feels like it flips z-order. Users think the card jumped positions, but it's just a preview.
Arjun Patel: Saw that. Can you attach a gif? From what I saw the preview drops elevation when moved which looks like it's above/below incorrectly. Maybe keep source card slightly translucent and show a thin insertion line.
Mia Chen: Yep. Also keyboard nav: focus ring disappears when preview overlay is active. That's an a11y fail — users lose context.
Devon (a11y): Confirmed. Focus ring contrast is under threshold on the dark toolbar. Recommend stronger outline + explicit focus state on the insertion point. Quick proposal: use a 3px solid token (example): `outline: 3px solid #F2B705` and aria announcement.
Devon (a11y): For screen readers we should add an aria-live message: ```aria-live="polite" text="Preview: will insert rule between 'Rate Limit' and 'Deny IP'"``` that updates while keyboard dragging.
Esther Gomez: Small copy tweak: current tooltip says "Drop to reorder" which is a bit vague. Suggest "Drop here to move rule and update priority" — explicit but still short. Could also show a quick-muted helper when you land on a group header: "Will move into group X".
Samir Kapoor: A couple implementation notes: the insertion line logic needs to account for collapsed groups and sticky headers. Also with virtualized lists the index can shift during drag — we need a stable visible-target calculation or a snap-to-visible strategy.
Arjun Patel: Snap-to-visible sounds good — instead of absolute pointer coords, snap the preview to the nearest visible row. Reduces the feeling of 'teleporting' cards.
Mia Chen: UI overlap: in sim-preview mode the simulated token-badge overlays the insertion line. Can we move the token badge into the preview pane top-right or fade it while dragging?
design-bot: Reminder — design review tomorrow 10:30am PT. Agenda: finalise insertion affordance, keyboard flows, and tooltip copy. @Devon (a11y) please bring contrast numbers and sample aria text. :calendar:
Devon (a11y): :thumbsup: I'll run axe + manual focus tests, paste results in the design doc, and include suggested aria strings.
Mia Chen: Thanks — if folks can add short gifs/screenshots before noon tomorrow that'd be super helpful for the review.
